v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.en: All ye nations * shout unto God with the voice of joy.

text.la: Inténde * voci oratiónis meæ, Rex meus et Deus meus.
text.en: Hearken to the voice * of my prayer, O my King and my God.

text.la: Deus maiestátis * intónuit: afférte glóriam nómini eius.
text.en: The God of majesty * hath thundered, ascribe to the Lord glory to his name.

text.la: Laudámus nomen tuum * ínclitum, Deus noster.
text.en: O God of majesty, * we praise thy glorious name.
O praise the Lord, * all ye nations. ‡

text.la: Ecce sacérdos magnus, qui in diébus suis plácuit Deo, et invéntus est iustus: et in témpore iracúndiæ factus est reconciliátio.
text.en: Behold an high priest, who in his days pleased God, and was found righteous, and in the time of wrath he was made a propitiation.

v.la: Iustum dedúxit Dóminus per vias rectas.
v.en: The Lord guided the just in right paths.

r.en: And showed him the kingdom of God.

text.la: Euge, serve bone * et fidélis, quia in pauca fuísti fidélis, supra multa te constítuam, dicit Dóminus.
text.en: Well done, thou good and faithful servant * thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things, saith the Lord.

text.la: Deus, qui pópulo tuo ætérnæ salútis beátum Ambrósium minístrum tribuísti: præsta, quǽsumus; ut, quem Doctórem vitæ habúimus in terris, intercessórem habére mereámur in cælis.
text.en: O God, who didst give blessed Ambrose to be thy people’s minister in eternal salvation; grant, we pray, that we who have him for teacher of life here on earth, may also deserve now that he is in heaven, to have him for an advocate.

title.la: Feria II infra Hebdomadam II Adventus
title.en: Feria II infra Hebdomadam II Adventus

text.la: De cælo véniet Dominátor Dóminus, et in manu eius honor et impérium.
text.en: The Lord the Ruler cometh from heaven, and in His hand are honour and dominion.

v.la: Vox clamántis in desérto: Paráte viam Dómini.
v.en: A voice of one crying in the wilderness: Prepare the way of the Lord.

text.la: Excita, Dómine, corda nostra ad præparándas Unigéniti tui vias: ut, per eius advéntum, purificátis tibi méntibus servíre mereámur:
text.en: Stir up our hearts, O Lord, to make ready the ways of thine Only-begotten Son, that by His coming our minds being purified, we may the more worthily give up ourselves to thy service: Who with thee liveth and reigneth, in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, world without end.

office.title: S. Ambrosii Episcopi Confessoris et Ecclesiæ Doctoris
